name: Francisco Assis - § 27 - Am 12
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 27. Is concerned that the systematic pro-migration rulings of the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) have left little leeway for returns and make it impossible to effectively combat illegal migration; considers that the ECtHR is placing the individual needs of deportees above public safety and the common good; insists that it is up to the elected governments in Europe to decide whether immigrants may reside on their territory;
